title: LLMs in Process Diagram Engineering: From Optimal PFDs to Validated P&IDs
abstract: arXiv:2608.11220v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nowadays, the creation of a process flow diagram (PFD) and its subsequent transformation into a piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID) is predominantly performed manually. Applying artificial intelligence in the task could potentially lead not only to process automation and time savings, but also to financial gains by exploring numerous diagram's topology options and reducing manual labor. This research presents P&ID Pilot - a practical end-to-end AI pipeline capable of handling flowsheet developing for both stages. The first stage focuses on PFD synthesis, whereas the second is directed toward modifying the generated PFD into P&ID. After comparing four different methods, the hybrid approach combining genetic algorithms (GA) and large language models (LLM) is shown to generate the optimal valid PFD topology, achieving the lowest loss value among all the methods, while satisfying the required outlet flow parameters without engineering-

translated_title: 大语言模型在工艺图工程中的应用：从最优流程图到验证过的管道仪表图
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11220v1 公告类型：新 摘要：如今，工艺流程图（PFD）的创建及其随后转化为管道和仪表图（P&ID）主要依赖人工完成。将人工智能应用于此任务，不仅可能实现流程自动化和节省时间，还能通过探索多种图拓扑选项和减少人工劳动来带来经济效益。本研究提出了P&ID Pilot——一个实用的端到端AI流水线，能够处理两个阶段的流程图开发。第一阶段专注于PFD合成，而第二阶段则致力于将生成的PFD修改为P&ID。在比较四种不同方法后，结合遗传算法（GA）和大语言模型（LLM）的混合方法被证明能生成最优的有效PFD拓扑，在所有方法中实现最低的损失值，同时满足所需的出口流量参数，且无需工程干预。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合遗传算法和大语言模型的混合AI流水线，能够自动生成最优的工艺流程图并转化为管道仪表图，显著优于其他方法。
en_tdlr: This research proposes a hybrid AI pipeline combining genetic algorithms and large language models to automatically generate optimal process flow diagrams and convert them into piping and instrumentation diagrams, outperforming other methods.
